en: A black‑and‑white rural scene showing a dirt road passing between wooden fenced fields and simple wooden houses with tiled roofs. Several people stand along the roadside, some near a horse and cart, giving the impression of a small village or farm center. The caption at the bottom reads "OTTESTAD. MEIERI". The image has the visual style of an early 20th‑century postcard.
